reviews.text: I have brought my dogs multiple times now and have always been super happy with the service! Sarah does an exceptionally great job and is super patient with our hyper dog
The customer service is great. The groomer was super sweet and took her time with my baby!! Great doodle cut!! I will be back!!

This review has been way overdue. We have been coming to Betty's for a little over a year I want to say. But they were pumpkins first groomers and they're definitely going to be his only as long as we're here. The customer service is great and I believe the puppy service is great as well. Pumpkin is always excited when he shows up and when he leaves he's more than happy. Every detail that I asked of them is overdone and accomplished. They've even waited for me even though they were closing. I work night shift and I slept through a couple alerts and phone calls. Thankfully they stayed persistent and I was able to pick up pumpkin within 5 minutes of the phone call. Even if it's a bathroom brush or a full groom I've been nothing but overly satisfied with their service. 10/10 recommend ☺️ it's a little more details needed I do have a 2-year-old pug who sheds a lot and his grooming is a must with all the shedding. They're more than happy to oblige with a little trim of the hind legs, like I mentioned before they spare no detail.
First time! Really good experience : )

1 missed appointnent with 3 dogs over 5 years as a customer. This 1 appointment now has it where I have to pay before services are rendered.   Bad enough when grooming you expect the nails to be cut. The last 3 visits 2 of my dogs nails were cut on 2 and 3 paws of the dogs 4 respectively
They did a beautiful job and were so professional, friendly, and nurturing to my two pets. I will be giving them more of my business for sure. Thank you ladies!
Everyone is friendly.  They always squeeze me in and they always give my doggy treats! No complaints.

I took my 5 month old puppy there this morning to see Alex. Before the owner Deb got there. She was kind told me she did not have very many clients so she could focus on her and she would be done in an hour and a half. I said the normal time is two and a half hours she said no problem. I showed her my shot record. I traveled an hour and a half in the worst traffic and rain. I come back in a half hour the owner is there. She acts like a completely different person. She says come back here. I go back she says her hair has mats. I brush her everyday. I do not comb her. She is very fine here she says watch she takes the metal comb and yanked it so hard. Was that necessary she continued two more times yanking it. Could she have stopped after the first time and said you need to get her some spray and comb her then bring her . Then I go to leave and this man says what's the matter he had just brought his bigger dogs in I told him the Deb runs outside and tries to harass me. Wow. If you have a silky Yorkie puppy do not go to this place. The bathroom also is filthy I had to use it.
Thank you for the 5 star review!  We appreciate you and your business
Incredible service to both the animals and the humans!
My babies don't mind going there. Alex takes such good care of them and they always look beautiful.

Absolutely terrible experience. The haircut was uneven and butchered beyond repair. To make matters worse, my dog started limping after the appointment—clearly mishandled. I later found actual burn marks from the clippers on his skin. Completely unacceptable and inhumane. The groomer had a nasty attitude and zero professionalism. When I expressed concern, they were rude, dismissive, and showed no remorse. This is not just bad service—it’s negligence and cruelty. Avoid this place at all costs if you care about your pet’s safety and well-being. I wouldn’t bring a stuffed animal here, let alone a living, breathing pet. Shameful.
If there was a option for a zero star id give it !!

Love Betty’s! I have been going there for years!! Only taking short breaks when my pups have had surgery or one got valley fever. They are patient and kind! 3 dogs of ours have been groomed there. Boomer, our sweet Cocker mix, Roxy, a very anxious soft coated Wheaton terrier w a sensitive neck does incredible here, and a new Cockapoo puppy Charlie! They are great at the full shave, which is sometimes needed, or the fluffy puppy cut that I absolutely LOVE! All of my dogs do amazing there and are happy and gorgeous when picked up! They also keep them together as best they can. Best part they call as soon as they are finished so they don’t sit in kennels all day. Most of the time they run around together and play upon pickup. They are fantastic! Half the time I stand in the entrance catching up and chatting for quite some time. It’s like visiting friends! 5 stars!
Betty's always takes such good care of our fur babies. I highly recommend them if you want a great grooming experience by people who treat them like they're their own.
We have been going here for years and will not go anywhere else! My baby Bella Rose has anxiety and they do such a wonderful job with her every single time!

When the groomer has more than three complaints about messing up the dogs eyes and then gets defensive about it you know that they have a problem. Where there’s smoke there’s fire 🔥 personally I wouldn’t recommend just because I love my dog too much …
Alex is our girl !! She always does a fabulous job!

My dogs eye is hurt after going in for grooming. We will not be returning. The worst part is staff lying about how he got hurt and trying to offer to help AFTER we noticed his eye was shut. Clearly, the groomer knew he was hurt and did NOTHING prior to us arriving.
Thank you Cynthia. 😊 …
I have taken my dog here for almost 2 years. Always great service 👍 …
Thank you Savannah 😊 …
Excellent
This place burned my dogs eyes. I went to pick him up and on both eyes the top layer of his eyes was peeling off. The recent times I took him here, he always had anxiety. Don’t recommend!
Delighted with the services
